scope.start: run_benchmark entry; excludes process startup, parsing and config resolution
scope.synchronization: all actual predictor return tensors copied to NumPy
scope.first_inference: includes first graph tracing and execution; never steady state
scope.writes: file writes and close/flush to OS cache; no fsync or physical-disk claim
scope.warmup: complete input passes including exports; recorded but excluded from measurements
scope.repeats: complete measured input passes with one model and predictor
scope.pipeline_seconds: sum of tile read/validation, preprocessing, inference/sync, postprocessing and array/image export; excludes CSV, directory operations and initialization
scope.cache: OS file caches are not cleared; repeated source reads may be cached
scope.report_write: prediction report write included in benchmark total; final benchmark JSON write excluded
scope.accuracy: no trained accuracy or real-data/GPU performance is established
scope.framework_import: timed separately; cached when already imported by caller
scope.steady_state: measured tiles excluding the first inference even when warmup is zero
scope.console: per-tile console output disabled; all prediction file exports retained
